notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Added in-game pause menu
Added improved rebinding menu
Added option to reset global progress



Updated a music track
Made it so Big Catch backseating doesn't loop
Made it so if Big Catch fight starts backseating gets canceled



Fixed Rat reset to default idle on Mall when you talk to her near fountain
Fixed Giraffe having wrong depth at mall
Fixed teammates not respawning if they die to knockoff crew and level restarts
Fixed Cafe Dragon showing wrong text
Fixed Cafe Dragon depth
Fixed knife description
Fixed butter minigame depth on a tie
Fixed cursor crash bug
Fixed bird shaking on couch at night after washing machine
Fixed boss music at Big Catch
Fixed crumb and key not drawing on base
Fixed white space being accessible through the open floor left bottom corner of the wall
Fixed mall characters talking after it was broken
Fixed being able to take damage by really slow projectiles at the end of fights
Fixed serious dialogues not playing when giving drawing kit
Fixed death counter rolling over incorrectly into 60 -> 51, etc
Some other miscellaneous fixes

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
A bunch of new very needed fixes.


Fixed possible crash after [spoiler]Big Catch punchout losses[/spoiler]
Fixed possible crash when talking to yourself in the mirror
Fixed softlock possible with elevator buttons in the [spoiler]mall[/spoiler]
Fixed default volume to be too high (sets to default 0.1, make higher as needed)
Fixed one of the endings not having a correct display or trigger condition [spoiler](Bizzare Ending)[/spoiler]
Fixed Bunny not finishing her idea on level selection screen after an anime watch
Fixed some [spoiler]mall[/spoiler] depth issues
Fixed portraits after anime watches sometimes disappearing
Fixed some anime watches skipping the text during Serious mode
Fixed Bunny locking Wolf at microwave scene by not resetting
Fixed Bird vibrating near microwave if microwave exploded and Bird was on washing machine
Fixed characters reacting to microwave at inappropriate moments
Fixed items becoming irretrievable from microwave at night
Fixed Bird flute audio persisting if Bird was moved

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Several issues have been found since release, this patch attempts to alleviate most of them:


Fixed possible softlock during [spoiler]butter minigame[/spoiler]
Fixed possible softlock during [spoiler]shooting minigame[/spoiler]
Fixed possible softlock during outro sequence of a fight
Fixed possible softlock during card selection screen if you Pause the game
Fixed possible crash when [spoiler]taking carrots from the Bird[/spoiler]
Fixed possible crash when you stand in front of TV with crew dead
Fixed crew commenting on TV obstruction even when far away
Fixed crew not saying anything when you gift with empty inventory
Fixed some typos (Updated localization files ːrassali_smirkː)


If you can ensure that you have updated the game and some of these still persist, please report them through comments or discussions.
Some other rare issues are still being worked out and some other typo fixes will come in later patches.
Please don't be shy to report issues that you find though, even if you think they might already have been reported. Unless you explicitly see other thread or comment about.

Thank you and have fun!
